facts.fact: A UNDP consultancy notice states that DHIS2, the Ministry of Health's electronic health information management system since 2018, has been scaled up to all counties and to some selected health facilities; the notice is undated and the fact is given its publication date.
The UNDP notice says DHIS2 reaches some selected health facilities besides all counties, and gives no number or share of facilities; the notice is undated and the fact is given its publication date.

The UNDP notice states that the Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 as South Sudan's electronic health information management system since 2018 and has a DHIS2 technical team, and that an HIS roadmap/plan was still to be reviewed and finalised; the notice is undated and the fact is given its publication date.
